entries.body: Fictional demonstration written for this reader. Rook and Neri are sample labels; no real team activity or verified delivery is represented.
entries.author: Demo Rook

entries.body: The pump is on loan until Friday. A leak appeared during the last inspection; returning it unrepaired would transfer the problem to the lender.
entries.author: Demo Neri

entries.body: Replace the western valve before returning the borrowed pump. Keep the damaged part for inspection and record the lender’s receipt.

entries.body: A replacement arrived, but its seal is narrower. Compare it with the old part before fitting it.
